The '''Farmer''' is a [[villager]] profession that sells seeds, flowers and young farm animals. Its job site block is the {{ItemLink|Composter}}. Unlike the vanilla farmer, it buys no crops.

All trades can be used 999 times before restocking.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/farmer/1/seed_bundle.json}}</ref>

* The Novice trades sell pre-filled [[bundles]]: the [[Bundles#Seed Bundle|Seed Bundle]], [[Bundles#Floral Bundle|Floral Bundle]], [[Bundles#Mushy Bundle|Mushy Bundle]] and [[Bundles#Exotic Seed Bundle|Exotic Seed Bundle]]. The Exotic Seed Bundle also costs a jungle sapling.
* The Apprentice and Journeyman trades sell [[livestock]]: fertilized eggs, calves and piglets, which are spawn eggs for baby animals. Each breed is only offered when the farmer is in a biome of the matching climate, so a farmer offers the chicken, cow and pig variants of its own region.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/farmer/2/blue_egg.json}}</ref> The biome lists are on the [[Livestock]] page.
* The farmer has no Expert or Master trades. Those levels use a placeholder trade that the game discards.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/farmer/4/filler.json}}</ref>

Like every villager, a farmer that has been traded with also buys its [[favorite food]] once.
